description: QA-010 performance budgets per device class. Raise thresholdsVersion by one whenever a limit, class or metric changes. Simulator and host results are never evidence.

fps1sP5.description: 5th percentile (nearest rank) of 1-second frame-rate windows (AutomationRunner perf001 fpsTimerOff); SC-005 form

frameIntervalP50Ms.description: PERF-012 frames.p50Ms: median interval between frames handed to the display

droppedFramePercent.description: PERF-007 device output: 100 x skipped / (submitted + skipped) refresh slots

audioAgeP95Ms.description: p95 age of audio when the renderer reads it; top-level audioAgeP95Ms of an AutomationRunner report (no mode writes it yet)

coldLaunchMs.description: largest sc015 cold-launch sample (process start to the source chooser) x 1000

fps1sP5.basis: SC-005 (95% of 1 s windows >= 55 fps, reference device)

frameIntervalP50Ms.basis: 1000 / 55 fps rounded up to the 0.1 ms PERF-012 resolution

frameIntervalP95Ms.basis: PERF-012 long-frame threshold 25 ms (1.5 refreshes at 60 Hz)

fps1sP5.basis: decided QA-010 2026-11-14: as D1 (60 fps on every preset at Gate 3)

frameIntervalP50Ms.basis: 1000 / 55 fps rounded up to the 0.1 ms PERF-012 resolution

frameIntervalP95Ms.basis: PERF-012 long-frame threshold 25 ms (1.5 refreshes at 60 Hz)

peakMemoryMB.basis: decided QA-010 2026-11-14: SC-008 budget (D2, D3 measured and published)

frameIntervalP50Ms.basis: 1000 / 30 fps rounded up to the 0.1 ms PERF-012 resolution

frameIntervalP95Ms.basis: PERF-012 long-frame threshold 50 ms (1.5 refreshes at 30 fps)

droppedFramePercent.basis: decided QA-010 2026-11-14: twice D1's share (oldest tier)

peakMemoryMB.basis: decided QA-010 2026-11-14: SC-008 budget (D2, D3 measured and published)
